Path prefixes used below: LAN = \\172.16.214.58\sap\LAN\WebApiMagento, SAP = \\172.16.214.58\sap\ServicioSAP\ServicioSap\ServicioSap, DMZ = \\172.16.214.58\sap\DMZ\WebApiMagento, MAG = \\172.16.214.58\sap\Magento248\Magento248\app\code, SPS = \\172.16.214.58\sap\.agents\skills\lan-sap-migration\SPsOrden, RB = ...\MappingMetods\PLAN_EJECUCION_SP_CREDITO_A_CODIGO.md. I re-read every line cited here.

A. credit/getSms (LAN)
1. The DMZ receives Magento's body {cuenta, idCarritoCliente, cliente}. It re-serializes the body with an extra nipCliente:null and forwards it with curl.Post("credit/getSms") to URL_INTELISIS (DMZ Controllers\CreditController.cs:67-76; DMZ Models\CreditRequest.cs:9-15; DMZ Helper\Curl.cs:22,93-106). Magento never sends the NIP (MAG Omnipro\MaviCredito\Model\CreditoManagement.php:355-357,410-412).
2. LAN controller: a null body returns 400. It then calls ProductosCredito_Nip(cuenta, int.Parse(idCarritoCliente), int.Parse(cliente)). Any exception, including a parse or overflow failure, returns 500. Otherwise the controller returns Ok(string) (LAN Controllers\CreditController.cs:24-44). The LAN NipRequest has no NIP field (LAN Models\CreditRequest.cs:8-13).
3. ProductosCredito_Nip calls VTASCodigoSMSEcommerce. It logs "INFO [cliente]" plus the result to credit.log and returns result.ToString(). Its outer catch returns "err" (LAN Metodos\CreditMethods.cs:21-48).
4. VTASCodigoSMSEcommerce runs everything inside one try; any exception is logged with Logger.SetOrder and returns -1 (:2102-2189). The steps:
 4.1 If idMagento > 0: UPDATE Cte SET IDMagento=@IdMagento WHERE Cliente=@Cliente (Intelisis; :2111-2114, :2191-2206).
 4.2 If Cte has no row for the customer (SELECT 1 FROM Cte WHERE Cliente=@Cliente), return 0 (:2116, :2177-2180, :2208-2222).
 4.3 idRef = GetIdRef, i.e. SELECT ISNULL(MAX(IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce),'') ... WHERE Cliente='{0}' AND IdCarrito={1}. It gives "0" when there is no row and "" on error (:2118, :2035-2065). telefonoValidado = SELECT TOP 1 LADA+Telefono FROM CteTel WHERE Tipo='Movil' AND Telefono!='0' AND LEN(Telefono)+LEN(Lada)=10 AND Cliente=@Cliente AND ValidacionTel=1 ORDER BY Fecha DESC, or null (:2119, :2224-2243).
 4.4 If idRef=="0": idRef = InsertCodigoVerificacion, which inserts Codigo = RIGHT('000000'+CAST(ABS(CHECKSUM(NEWID()))%1000000 AS VARCHAR(6)),6), FechaRegristro=GETDATE(), FechaExpira=+2 min, Estatus=1, and returns the new MAX id, or "" on its own caught error (:2121-2123, :2067-2100). If there is a phone: InsertSendingSms, then return 3 (:2125-2129). With no phone it falls through to return 0, and the code row stays written (:2182).
 4.5 Otherwise: idRef = GetIdRef again, and estatus = SELECT TOP 1 EstatusEnvio FROM TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes WHERE Cliente=@Cliente AND IdMensaje=23 ORDER BY Id DESC (:2133-2134, :2264-2279).
   - "1": return 3 and write nothing (:2136-2139).
   - "2" or "3": codigo = SELECT Codigo ... WHERE Cliente AND IdCarrito, with no ORDER BY (:2143, :2281-2297). Then INSERT a new row with the SAME code, +2 min and Estatus 1 (:2147-2158), and set idRef = GetIdRef. With a phone: InsertSendingSms and return 3; otherwise 0 (:2162-2168).
   - Empty status with a phone: InsertSendingSms with the existing idRef, then return 3 (:2170-2174).
   - Anything else: return 0 (:2182).
 4.6 InsertSendingSms = INSERT TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes (IdRegistro=@IdRef, IdMensaje 23, Cliente, FechaEnvio GETDATE(), EstatusEnvio 1, ClienteF NULL, Tipo 0, IntentoRespuesta 0, IntentoEnvio 0, Modem NULL, Identificador 'DM0363', Telefono=@TelefonoValidado) (:2245-2262). LAN never calls an SMS provider. A dispatcher reads this table (SPS\SPVTASCodigoSeguridadeCommerce.sql:83).
5. The C# path never returns 1: a missing validated phone yields 0 (:2102-2189). The "1 = sin numero" comment at :38 is stale.
6. DMZ mapping: "0" → 400 "Error de credenciales"; "1" → 400 "Error de telefono"; "3" → 200 "Correcto"; "err" or anything else → 400 with an empty body (DMZ CreditController.cs:78-95). Magento: 200 → "Correcto" and the body is ignored. "Error de credenciales" → 401 "Número de cuenta inválida". An empty or unknown body → "error de conexión" (CreditoManagement.php:304-340).

B. credit/validateSms (LAN)
7. The DMZ forwards {cuenta, claveSms, idCarritoCliente} with curl.Post (DMZ CreditController.cs:98-107). LAN controller: null body → 400. It calls ProductosCredito_Clave(cuenta, claveSms, int.Parse(idCarritoCliente)); an exception → 500 (LAN CreditController.cs:46-66).
8. ProductosCredito_Clave runs SP SPVTASCodigoSeguridadeCommerce on ServicioAndroid with @Cliente VarChar, @IdCarrito Int, @CodigoWeb=claveSms, @Op='CODIGO', CommandTimeout 60, and returns the ReturnValue as a string. On an exception it returns e.Message without logging (LAN Metodos\CreditMethods.cs:50-92).
9. SP params: @Cliente varchar(15), @IdCarrito int, @CodigoWeb varchar(35) (SPS\SPVTASCodigoSeguridadeCommerce.sql:18-22). The CODIGO branch is IF (SELECT TOP 1 IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce FROM VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce WHERE Cliente=@Cliente AND IdCarrito=@IdCarrito AND Codigo=@CodigoWeb) > 0 RETURN 5 ELSE RETURN 6 (:143-161). It does not check FechaExpira or Estatus, does not count attempts and never marks the code as used.
10. DMZ mapping: "5" → 200 "Correcto"; "6" → 400 "Error de credenciales"; anything else → 400 with an empty body (DMZ CreditController.cs:109-123).

C. Surrounding behaviour (unchanged by the port)
11. Attempts are counted only in Magento. The browser blocks at tries()>=3 (MAG Mavi\CreditoCheckout\view\frontend\web\js\credito-checkout-functions.js:213,252). The server-side limit is commented out (CreditoManagement.php:451-453). Resend is simply getSms again.
12. After a successful validation nothing happens on the server. The order later reads the SMS phone: SAP Methods\Order\OrderMethods.cs:589-613 (called with the BP at :1804) and SAP Methods\Credit\SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:333-370 (the port of SPS\SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:204-208).

D. Where the maps disagreed, and what the code says
- Is "1" a live getSms code? No. Only 3, 0 and -1 are returned (:2102-2189), and "err" only from the outer catch (:42-46).
- Does validateSms check expiry? No (SP :143-161). The contract map's "6 = mismatch or expired" is wrong.
- Customer key, 'C...' or BP? BP. The user decided that ServicioSAP targets the final state with numeric BPs, and that rejecting 'C...' is transitional and intentional (C:\Users\claude\.claude\projects\C--x\memory\sap-migration-sp-credito-estado-implementacion.md). The ServicioSAP readers also key on the BP: cuentaBp at SAP OrderMethods.cs:669, :681 and :1804. So Cliente = BP, and a 'C...' account gets "0" from the SAP existence check. The contract map's advice to accept 'C...' is not followed; the consequence is a cutover-timing constraint (see risks).
design.contract:
Must stay unchanged: Magento (all of it) and the DMZ switch/Trim mapping, models and logs (DMZ Controllers\CreditController.cs:67-124). The only DMZ edit is at cutover: curl.Post → curl.PostSAP at DMZ CreditController.cs:76 and :107, the same pattern already used at :308 (DMZ Helper\Curl.cs:115-127). The JWT is already the ServicioSAP token: Curl logs in only at URL_SAP login/auth, and the LAN login is commented out (Curl.cs:57-90).

1) POST {URL_SAP}credit/getSms
- Where: existing CreditController, which already has [Authorize] and [RoutePrefix("credit")] (SAP Controllers\CreditController.cs:9-11). No route named getSms or validateSms exists in any ServicioSAP controller.
- Request, application/json, every value a JSON string as the DMZ re-serializes it:
  {"cuenta":"<10-digit BP, e.g. 1500007539>","nipCliente":null,"idCarritoCliente":"<Magento quote id>","cliente":"<Magento customer id, \"0\" for guests>"}
  nipCliente is ignored. cliente > 0 triggers the ZidMagento stamp.
- Response: always HTTP 200 with a JSON string body produced by Ok(string), e.g. "3".
  - "3" = SMS queued, or a previous one is still pending (EstatusEnvio 1).
  - "0" = the BP does not exist, OR it has no validated 10-digit MOVIL phone (LAN parity; "1" is never emitted).
  - "-1" = an exception in the business steps.
  - "err" = an exception outside them.
- Non-business failures, same as LAN: null body → 400 (HttpResponseException BadRequest); an int.Parse failure on idCarritoCliente or cliente → 500. The DMZ turns both into a 400 with an empty body.
- No {"result":n} wrapper; that shape belongs to SendSmsNewNumber only.

2) POST {URL_SAP}credit/validateSms
- Request: {"cuenta":"<BP>","claveSms":"<Magento input, up to 8 alphanumeric characters>","idCarritoCliente":"<quote id>"}.
- Response: HTTP 200 with a JSON string: "5" = a row matches Cliente+IdCarrito+Codigo; "6" = no match.
- "err" = exception, or a null cuenta/claveSms. LAN's SP call fails without them and returns e.Message; the DMZ maps any non-5/6 value to 400 exactly as it maps "err" (DMZ CreditController.cs:117-121).
- Null body → 400; int.Parse failure → 500.

3) What Magento ends up seeing (unchanged): 200 'Correcto'; 401 'Número de cuenta inválida' (getSms "0"); 401 'Codigo de SMS no válido' (validate "6"); 'Ha ocurrido un error de conexión' for anything else (MAG Omnipro\MaviCredito\Model\CreditoManagement.php:304-340).

4) Database write contract. The order side reads exactly these rows, so the port must write exactly this:
- VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce: Cliente = the cuenta string as received (the same BP that order/new later carries in infoCliente.cuenta), IdCarrito = quote id, Codigo = the 6-digit SQL expression, FechaRegristro GETDATE(), FechaExpira +2 min, Estatus 1.
- TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes: IdRegistro = that row's IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce, IdMensaje 23, Cliente = the same BP, EstatusEnvio 1, Identificador 'DM0363', Telefono = the 10-digit ZtelCte. Remaining columns as LAN: ClienteF NULL, Tipo 0, IntentoRespuesta 0, IntentoEnvio 0, Modem NULL.
- Reader A joins on IdRegistro, then VTASD.Cliente=@Cliente, TOP 1 ORDER BY Id DESC (SAP OrderMethods.cs:597-600).
- Reader B filters EnvioMensajes.Cliente=@cliente, TOP 1 ORDER BY Id DESC (SAP SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:341-344).
- Neither reader filters on IdMensaje, so SendSmsNewNumber rows (SAP Methods\Credit\CreditMethods.cs:134-141) count too, as in LAN.

5) SAP calls, using existing methods only; no new Web.config key:
- GET ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE_CDS (SAP BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:27-69)
- GET ZQBP_EDITARCLIENTE_SRV/CteTelSet (SAP SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:406-445)
- PATCH ZSDT_CTE_ODATA_SRV/ZSDT_CTE_ENTITYSet(ZclienteBp) {ZidMagento} with CSRF (SAP BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:833-873)
- No PUT.

open_questions: Scope and cutover date. With a BP account, LAN's GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName (DMZ still routes it to LAN, DMZ CreditController.cs:289-299) cannot find the customer in Intelisis. Magento then keeps the checkout button disabled (MAG ...omnipro_pago_credito-method.js:448), and the Magento JS still accepts only /C\d{8}/ (:292, :404). So the ported getSms/validateSms cannot be reached from Magento until (a) Magento sends BPs and (b) that gate is ported. Recommendation: port GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName next, as a separate spec using the same phone helper. Flip DMZ :76, :107 and that route to PostSAP in the same release that switches Magento to BPs. Until then leave the DMZ on curl.Post, because flipping earlier makes every 'C...' customer get 'Número de cuenta inválida'.

What to do when the ZidMagento PATCH fails (the Cte.IDMagento equivalent). LAN parity: any failure returns -1, so logged-in customers get 'error de conexión' and no SMS (LAN CreditMethods.cs:2111-2114, 2184-2188). LinkMagentoAccountAsync has never been seen to run (no '[SAP ZidMagento PATCH' tag in SAP Logs\sap.log), and whether the technical user is authorized on ZSDT_CTE_ODATA_SRV is unknown. Recommendation: keep LAN parity, but prove the PATCH once on test BP 1500007539 before the DMZ switch. If you prefer resilience, the alternative is log-and-continue: a small deviation that matters only on failure.

Go-ahead for the tests that write. A positive getSms queues a row that the dispatcher sends as a REAL SMS to the BP's validated mobile, and it adds 2 rows to ServicioAndroid, which LAN shares (SAP Web.config:13; RB §18.4). With cliente > 0 it also PATCHes the SAP BP. Recommendation: approve only for the agreed test BP 1500007539 (E-01_SendSmsNewNumber.md:204), and only after you confirm its validated MOVIL phone belongs to the team and paste the column widths from the DDL query in the testing section.
risks: The dispatcher SpAAea00030_ArmadoSMS is not on the share; it is only named at SPS\SPVTASCodigoSeguridadeCommerce.sql:83. No BP-keyed row has ever gone through it: on 6 Aug all EnvioMensajes rows were 'C' accounts (E-01_SendSmsNewNumber.md:202). If it joins Cliente to Intelisis Cte or CteTel, a BP row is never sent and EstatusEnvio stays 1. Every later getSms would then return 3 without queuing anything (the LAN :2136-2139 branch), and the customer never receives a code. The first positive test is the proof.

Widths of Cliente/Telefono/IdCarrito in the two SMS tables: NO EVIDENCE from DDL. The only source is a document claim that Cliente is varchar(10) (E-01_SendSmsNewNumber.md:200), which leaves zero margin for a 10-digit BP. The SP parameter is varchar(15) (SPS :18). The RB §22.3 DDL covered only CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP.

ExistingCustomerAsync relies on the message text 'No se encontraron clientes' (SAP BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:58,67). If someone changes that text, an unknown BP becomes -1 ('error de conexión') instead of 0. Whether SAP answers a 'C...' value with 0 rows or an error is an E2E item.

ZtelCte as equivalent of LAN's Lada+Telefono, and the wire format of Zfecha from CteTelSet (FechaSap handles /Date(ms)/ and parseable strings; anything else sorts last), are E2E items per SKILL rule 29. They are not established by reading. The same goes for System.Text.Json binding of Zvaltel if SAP returns null.

The order side is still inconsistent with the phone that getSms texts (pending Q4, RB :1862 and :1932). @TelefonoValidado comes from A_GET_TelefonoValidado, which picks the newest phone of any type (RB §22.4). IsValidatedAsync is unsorted and adds a ZappOrig check (SAP OrderMethods.cs:646-651). So ValidacionTelefono can come out as 1 even when the SMS went to the validated mobile.
Carts in flight at the switch have codes keyed by 'C...'. They will not match the BP key, so those customers must press resend. No data migration is proposed.

Validation through JoinAccount: IdCarrito = customer_id + the last 4 digits of the timestamp (MAG Mavi\JoinAccount\Model\Api\JoinAccountManagement.php:205). This overflows int.Parse for customer_id >= 214749 and returns 500, which JoinAccount reads as false. It behaves the same as LAN and is kept.

Reused GetIdRefAsync builds its SQL with string.Format (SAP CreditMethods.cs:165-167). It is safe in getSms only because the BP is checked against SAP first and IdCarrito is an int, so do not call it from validateSms. SendSmsNewNumberAsync's INSERT is still built with string.Format (:137-141), which is out of scope.
The DMZ logs the whole validateSms request, SMS code included, in clear (DMZ CreditController.cs:102). This is existing behaviour and unchanged.
BusinessPartnerMethods.cs and SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs have uncommitted work by others (memory note of 2026-09-25). The spec limits edits there to two visibility keywords.

Local DMZ → ServicioSAP tests may fail on certificates. TrustedHosts compares the bare host with DOMINIO_LAN/DOMINIO_SAP values that hold full URLs (DMZ Helper\Curl.cs:29-33,50; E-01_SendSmsNewNumber.md:234-242).
design.testing:
Constraints. The project has no usable fakes; the Fakes folders are stale (memory note). Agents do not build, run SQL or call endpoints. The user builds with the VS18 MSBuild, with OutDir redirected off the share. Magento cannot be used end to end until it sends BPs, because its JS regex only accepts C accounts (MAG ...omnipro_pago_credito-method.js:292,404). Testing is therefore done directly against ServicioSAP with a JWT from login/auth, then through a local DMZ switched to PostSAP.

What writes where:
- getSms may INSERT one VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce row, for a new code or a resend copy.
- getSms may INSERT one TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes row with EstatusEnvio 1. The dispatcher then sends a REAL SMS to that phone.
- When cliente > 0, getSms PATCHes ZidMagento on the SAP BP (mandante 110).
- getSms reads SAP with a GET on ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE_CDS and a GET on CteTelSet.
- validateSms only runs a SELECT.
ServicioAndroid is the same database LAN uses (SAP Web.config:13; LAN Conn\Connection.cs:28), so a written row is live.

How to avoid texting customers:
- Use only the agreed test BP 1500007539 (E-01_SendSmsNewNumber.md:204).
- Before any write, read its phones through ServicioSAP GET partner/client/ma/{BP} (to_CteTel) and confirm with the user that the phone the LAN rule would pick belongs to the team.
- Run the no-write cases first.

Order of tests:
(0) Read-only; the user runs these and pastes the output.
 - SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME IN ('VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce','TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION;
 - SELECT GETDATE(), (SELECT MAX(Id) FROM TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes); this is the E-01 check against a stale copy of the database (E-01_SendSmsNewNumber.md:187-193).
(1) validateSms with no writes, against an existing row (e.g. one left by the E-01 tests; the user reads its Cliente, IdCarrito and Codigo with a SELECT). Right code → "5", wrong code → "6", a non-numeric idCarritoCliente → 500, null body → 400.
(2) getSms with no writes. An unknown BP (e.g. 0000000000) and a 'C...' account → "0", with no rows and no PATCH (existence is checked first). Send cliente "0" in all first runs so the PATCH is skipped.
(3) With the user's go-ahead: getSms with BP 1500007539, cliente "0" and a fresh idCarritoCliente. Expect "3", one VTASD row and one EnvioMensajes row (Cliente = BP, IdRegistro = the new Id, IdMensaje 23, DM0363, a 10-digit Telefono), and one SMS on the team phone. That SMS proves the dispatcher accepts BP keys.
 - Call again at once → "3" and no new rows (status 1).
 - Once the user sees EstatusEnvio 2 or 3 → a new VTASD row with the SAME Codigo and a new queue row.
 - validateSms with that code → "5".
 - The user then runs the two reader queries for the BP, with the same text as SAP OrderMethods.cs:597-600 and SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:341-344, and confirms the phone.
(4) With a separate go-ahead: cliente > 0 for the PATCH. Check '[SAP ZidMagento PATCH RESPONSE]' in Logs\sap.log.
(5) Local DMZ with PostSAP: check the mapping to 200 "Correcto" / 400 "Error de credenciales" / 400 empty.
Cleanup of test rows is the user's call; agents delete nothing. Record the request and exact response of every run (SKILL rule 25).
design.effort: Small to medium. ServicioSAP needs about 200-250 lines: 2 controller actions, 1 new model file plus 1 csproj line, 8 private or public methods in CreditMethods, and 2 visibility keywords in SolicitudCreditoWebMethods. The DMZ needs 2 lines at cutover. That is about 1 developer day including review. Tests need the user at each step (DDL widths, confirming the test phone, go-ahead for writes). The DMZ switch and a Magento end-to-end run wait for Magento to send BPs and for GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName to be ported.

maps.summary:
How the NIP SMS feature works in LAN today, traced from start to finish (read-only, every claim has a file:line).

1. **Call chain.** The Magento checkout calls /rest/V1/omnipro-credito/validateUser, validateUserNewNumber or validateSms. Magento posts to the DMZ, and the DMZ forwards to LAN POST credit/getSms and credit/validateSms. SendSmsNewNumber is the exception: the DMZ already sends it to ServicioSAP, where it is ported.

2. **The NIP is not checked.** The route name is misleading. LAN C# replaced the NIP branch of SPVTASCodigoSeguridadeCommerce with its own method, VTASCodigoSMSEcommerce. That method does:
   - stamps the Magento customer id into Cte.IDMagento;
   - checks that the customer exists in Cte;
   - reads the newest validated mobile phone from CteTel (lada + number = 10 digits).

3. **Code generation and SMS queue.** The code is generated by SQL Server: 6 numeric digits from ABS(CHECKSUM(NEWID())) % 1000000, stored in ServicioAndroid.VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce with FechaExpira = now + 2 minutes and Estatus = 1. The SMS is only queued as a row in TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes (IdMensaje 23, DM0363, EstatusEnvio 1, Telefono). According to a comment in the SP, a separate procedure, SpAAea00030_ArmadoSMS, sends it. LAN never calls an SMS provider.

4. **Resend.** Resend is the same getSms call. If the code already exists and the last send status for that customer (IdMensaje 23) is 2 or 3, LAN copies the same code into a new row and queues another SMS. If the status is 1, nothing is queued.

5. **Validation.** validateSms runs the SP branch @Op='CODIGO'. It returns 5 (accepted) if any row matches Cliente + IdCarrito + Codigo, otherwise 6. It does not check expiry or status, does not count attempts and does not mark the code as used. Nothing else in LAN or the SP reads FechaExpira.

6. **Attempts.** They are counted only in Magento:
   - the table omnipro_credito_sms stores intentos_sms and intentos_validate_sms, but the server-side limit is commented out;
   - the browser blocks after 3 failed tries and waits 300 seconds before a resend.

7. **After a successful validation, LAN does nothing server-side.** No CteTel update and no new row. The effect comes later, when the credit order is placed:
   - OrderMethods takes the phone from the queue (ObtenerNumeroTablaSms) and compares it with the CteTel validated phone;
   - it splits the lada: 2 digits for 33/55/81, otherwise 3;
   - it passes @LadaValidar, @TelefonoValidar and @ValidacionTelefono to SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS;
   - the SP recalculates @ValidacionTelefono from @TelefonoAValidar (newest queue phone for the customer) and writes all three to CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP.

8. **Customer id.** LAN uses the Intelisis account C######## for the Cliente column of both tables. IdCarrito is the Magento quote id. The Magento customer id is used only for Cte.IDMagento.

9. **What this means for the port.** ServicioSAP already reads the queue by BP (OrderMethods.cs:1804, SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:343), so the ported getSms must write Cliente = BP. Both systems use the same database: MAVICBOSANDROID in ServicioSAP points to the same host and ServicioAndroid database that LAN hardcodes. GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName (the checkout's phone gate) also has no ServicioSAP equivalent yet and still goes to LAN.

10. **Existing faults to decide on (keep or fix):**
   - When there is no validated phone, LAN returns 0 (shown as "Número de cuenta inválida"). The "Error de telefono" code 1 is never returned in C#.
   - Magento does not throw on unknown errors, and it treats SendSmsNewNumber result -1 as success.
   - Several queries build SQL from strings (injection risk).
   - The DMZ defaults EsCredito to true, so new-number SMS from the credit checkout go out as IdMensaje 23.
   - The same validateSms route is also used by Magento's JoinAccount flow.

items.topic: End-to-end call chain (send and validate)
items.detail: Browser (Mavi/CreditoCheckout credito-checkout-functions.js reSendSmsCode :163-210, and Omnipro payment renderer sendSmsCode :750-785) POSTs to Magento REST /V1/omnipro-credito/validateUser (validated phone) or /V1/omnipro-credito/validateUserNewNumber (typed phone); url choice at credito-checkout-functions.js:175-177 and omnipro_pago_credito-method.js:757-759; payload account, nip "0000", cart_id, guest, new_phone, customer_id, same_as_validated. Validation: /V1/omnipro-credito/validateSms with account, sms_code, cart_id, guest, is_validated, is_new_number (credito-checkout-functions.js:217-225). Magento PHP (Omnipro/MaviCredito/Model/CreditoManagement.php) posts to configurable endpoints omnipro_intelisisintegration/mavi_credito/sms_endpoint, validate_sms_endpoint, get_sms_number_novalidated_endpoint (Helper/Data.php:21-47). DMZ credit/getSms and credit/validateSms forward to LAN via curl.Post (AppSettings URL_INTELISIS); DMZ credit/SendSmsNewNumber forwards to ServicioSAP via curl.PostSAP (AppSettings URL_SAP, host kdll3fhcyo-lan.grupomavi.com); DMZ credit/GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName forwards to LAN. The Magento REST route /V1/omnipro-credito/getSms also exists (webapi.xml:9-14) but the frontends found call validateUser, which hits the same sms_endpoint.

items.topic: LAN route POST credit/getSms: contract
items.detail: [Authorize], RoutePrefix credit, HttpPost Route getSms. Request NipRequest {cuenta: string (Intelisis account), idCarritoCliente: string (Magento quote id), cliente: string (Magento customer entity id)}. There is no NIP field in the LAN model (the DMZ model has nipCliente, which is dropped, and Magento does not send it: body = cuenta, idCarritoCliente, cliente at CreditoManagement.php:410-412 / :355-357). Null body → 400. The controller calls cm.ProductosCredito_Nip(nip.cuenta, int.Parse(nip.idCarritoCliente), int.Parse(nip.cliente)). Any exception, including a parse failure → 500. Response: Ok(string), a JSON string: "3" (SMS queued or already pending), "0" (customer missing, no validated phone, or other status), "-1" (exception in VTASCodigoSMSEcommerce), "err" (exception in ProductosCredito_Nip). The comment's "1 = sin numero telefonico" is never returned by the C# path. The regex rx ^[C]{1}[0-9]{8}$ is declared but not applied to this route.

items.topic: getSms business logic: VTASCodigoSMSEcommerce decision tree
items.detail: ProductosCredito_Nip → VTASCodigoSMSEcommerce(cliente, idCarrito, idMagento). (1) If idMagento>0, UpdateMagentoId. (2) If !ExistingCustomer(cliente) → return 0. (3) idRef = GetIdRef(cliente, idCarrito); telefonoValidado = GetValidatedPhoneNumber(cliente). (4) If idRef=="0" (no code for Cliente+IdCarrito): InsertCodigoVerificacion (new code). If a validated phone exists: InsertSendingSms(idRef, cliente, phone) → return 3. Otherwise fall through → return 0 (a code row is created but no SMS). (5) Else (code exists): estatusSms = GetSmsStatus(cliente). "1" → return 3 with nothing queued (previous SMS still pending). "2" or "3" → codigo = GetVerificationCode, then INSERT a new VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce row with the SAME code, FechaExpira = GETDATE()+2 min, Estatus 1; idRef = new MAX id. If a validated phone exists: InsertSendingSms → 3, otherwise 0. Empty status with a validated phone → InsertSendingSms with the existing idRef → 3. Any other status → 0. (6) Exception → Logger.SetOrder and return -1. This C# method replaced the SP NIP branch (added in commit 5781cbc, 2026-05-12). The SP is still called only for CODIGO.

items.topic: Resend behaviour
items.detail: There is no separate resend route: resend = calling getSms again (Magento validateUser) after the client timer (credito-checkout-functions.js:163-203, timerValue 300 s). Server side, the resend branch reuses the existing code: it copies Codigo from GetVerificationCode (SELECT Codigo FROM VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce WHERE Cliente=@Cliente AND IdCarrito=@IdCarrito, ExecuteScalar with no ORDER BY) into a new row with a fresh FechaExpira. It only queues when the last EnvioMensajes status for the customer (IdMensaje=23, any cart, ORDER BY Id DESC) is 2 or 3, or is empty. Status 1 suppresses the resend but still returns 3. In the idRef=="0" branch the status is not checked. SendSmsNewNumber has no throttle: every call queues a row.

items.topic: NIP/code generation and storage (VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce, ServicioAndroid)
items.detail: InsertCodigoVerificacion: INSERT INTO VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce (Cliente, Codigo, IdCarrito, FechaRegristro, FechaExpira, Estatus) VALUES (@Cliente, RIGHT('000000' + CAST(ABS(CHECKSUM(NEWID())) % 1000000 AS VARCHAR(6)), 6), @IdCarrito, GETDATE(), DATEADD(MINUTE, 2, GETDATE()), 1). So the code is 6 numeric digits with leading zeros, generated by SQL Server from NEWID/CHECKSUM (not cryptographic, and a small modulo bias). Parameterized. On success it returns GetIdRef (the MAX id). On error it logs to Logger.Credit and returns "". Before commit 970d5b1 (2026-08-24), non-credit codes were LEFT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(36), NEWID()), 8); the legacy SP used LEFT(NEWID(),8) (SP :73). GetIdRef: SELECT ISNULL(MAX(IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce), '') AS IdRef FROM VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce WHERE Cliente='{0}' AND IdCarrito={1}. It is built with string.Format (not parameterized) and returns "0" when no row exists (ISNULL(int,'') yields 0), or "" on error. Columns seen: IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce, Cliente, Codigo, IdCarrito, FechaRegristro (sic), FechaExpira, Estatus.

items.topic: Expiry, attempts, one-time use
items.detail: FechaExpira (now + 2 min) and Estatus (=1) are written but never read: nothing in LAN C# or in SPVTASCodigoSeguridadeCommerce filters on them, and the CODIGO comparison ignores both. The code therefore stays valid indefinitely for that Cliente+IdCarrito and can be reused after success. No attempt counter on the server. Attempts live only in Magento: table omnipro_credito_sms (id, cuenta, intentos_sms, intentos_validate_sms, quote_id, created_at, updated_at). getSms increments intentos_sms, validateUser resets it to 1, validateSms increments intentos_validate_sms. The server-side limit (>=3) is commented out and const LIMIT=5 is unused. The browser blocks validateSms when tries()>=3 and resets tries on resend.

items.topic: SMS enqueue (TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes, ServicioAndroid)
items.detail: InsertSendingSms: INSERT INTO TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes (IdRegistro, IdMensaje, Cliente, FechaEnvio, EstatusEnvio, ClienteF, Tipo, IntentoRespuesta, IntentoEnvio, Modem, Identificador, Telefono) VALUES (@IdRef, 23, @Cliente, GETDATE(), 1, NULL, 0, 0, 0, NULL, 'DM0363', @TelefonoValidado). Parameterized. IdRegistro links to VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce.IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce. The code itself is not in the row, so the dispatcher must join by IdRegistro. GetSmsStatus: SELECT TOP 1 EstatusEnvio FROM TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes WHERE Cliente=@Cliente AND IdMensaje=23 ORDER BY Id DESC. The legacy SP inserted the same row without Telefono.

items.topic: SMS provider / message text
items.detail: LAN never calls an SMS provider for this feature. It only writes the queue row with EstatusEnvio=1. The SP comment says TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes is read by SP SpAAea00030_ArmadoSMS to send the SMS. The template catalog is ServicioAndroid.dbo.TcAAEA00030_Mensajes (IdMensaje, Descripcion), resolved by Descripcion in SpCREDICodigoRecomendador. For reference only, not used by LAN: businesspartner-dev exposes A_POST_EnviarSMS and A_POST_ValidarNIP. Both proxy to env WS_MENSAJERIA_BASE_URL (host stgsvrwea01.mavi.mx:6058, WsMensajeria/api/Message) with '/' or '/validate'. It also exposes A_POST_SMSEnviar, which invokes lambda L_POST_EnvioMensaje-dev with payload cols.Telefono.

items.topic: Phone / lada handling in getSms
items.detail: GetValidatedPhoneNumber (IntelisisTmp): SELECT TOP 1 CAST(CT.LADA AS varchar) + '' + CAST(CT.Telefono AS varchar) FROM CteTel WHERE Tipo='Movil' AND Telefono!='0' AND (LEN(Telefono)+LEN(Lada))=10 AND Cliente=@Cliente AND ValidacionTel=1 ORDER BY Fecha DESC. The 10-digit concatenation is what goes to EnvioMensajes.Telefono. There is no AppOrigen/TablaStD check here, unlike IsInTableStd. The SMS always goes to the phone already validated in CteTel. A phone typed by the user goes only through SendSmsNewNumber, which strips non-digits (Regex [^0-9]) with no length check.

items.topic: Intelisis reads/writes in getSms (to replace with SAP)
items.detail: UpdateMagentoId: UPDATE Cte SET IDMagento=@IdMagento WHERE Cliente=@Cliente (IntelisisTmp; runs when Magento customer id > 0). ExistingCustomer: SELECT 1 FROM Cte WHERE Cliente=@Cliente. GetValidatedPhoneNumber: CteTel (see the phone item). These three use sCadenaConexion (IntelisisTmp). The code and queue tables use sCadenaConexionAndriod (ServicioAndroid), which is not Intelisis. SAP-side equivalents already in ServicioSAP: GetClientMaAsync → To_CteTel (ZtelCte, Zvaltel, ZappOrig, ZtipoCte 'MOVIL'), used by IsValidatedAsync. LinkMagentoAccountAsync writes ZidMagento via PATCH on ZSDT_CTE_ODATA_SRV. businesspartner-dev exposes BP field Znipventa via A_GET_NIPCompra and CteTelSet via ZQBP_EDITARCLIENTE_SRV.

items.topic: LAN route POST credit/validateSms: contract and comparison
items.detail: Request ClaveRequest {cuenta, claveSms, idCarritoCliente}. The controller calls ProductosCredito_Clave(cuenta, claveSms, int.Parse(idCarritoCliente)); an exception → 500. ProductosCredito_Clave runs SP SPVTASCodigoSeguridadeCommerce on sCadenaConexionAndriod with @Cliente varchar, @IdCarrito int, @CodigoWeb varchar=claveSms, @Op='CODIGO', @retValue ReturnValue, CommandTimeout 60. It returns the value as a string: "5" (accepted) or "6" (no match). On an exception it returns e.Message (not logged). SP CODIGO branch: IF (SELECT TOP 1 IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce FROM VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce WHERE Cliente=@Cliente AND IdCarrito=@IdCarrito AND Codigo=@CodigoWeb) > 0 RETURN 5 ELSE RETURN 6. Exact equality on any row of the pair. No expiry, Estatus, attempts or update. SP params: @Cliente varchar(15), @CodigoWeb varchar(35).

items.topic: SP NIP branch (legacy, not used by LAN)
items.detail: @Op='NIP': it stamps ERPMAVI.IntelisisTmp.Cte.IDMagento and requires Cte.NIPVenta=@CodigoWeb (otherwise RETURN 0). It then requires the newest CteTel row of Tipo MOVIL (ORDER BY Fecha DESC) to have ValidacionTel=1 (otherwise RETURN 1). Next it generates LEFT(NEWID(),8), queues IdMensaje 23/DM0363 without Telefono, and returns 3. Its resend logic for status 1 and status 2/3 matches the C# logic. LAN calls the SP only with 'CODIGO', so the NIPVenta check is gone from the live flow (region 'Remover NIP').

items.topic: Route POST credit/SendSmsNewNumber (new-phone path; already in ServicioSAP)
items.detail: Request {Cliente, NumeroTelefono, IdCarrito, EsCredito}. LAN: strip non-digits; GetIdRef; if "0", InsertCodigoVerificacion (a new 6-digit code); if idRef is empty → {"result":-1}. It then runs INSERT TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes with IdMensaje = EsCredito?23:60 and Identificador = EsCredito?'DM0363':'DM0312', Telefono = typed phone. This insert is built with string.Format (not parameterized). Response {"result": RecordsAffected}, or -1 on exception (Logger.SetOrder). An existing code is reused with no new expiry. Magento validateUserNewNumber sends only Cliente, NumeroTelefono, IdCarrito. The DMZ model defaults EsCredito=true, so credit new-number SMS are queued as 23/DM0363. The DMZ forwards to ServicioSAP (PostSAP). ServicioSAP already has the same logic. Second caller: Magento JoinAccount postApiSendSMS sends EsCredito=false with IdCarrito = customer_id + last 4 digits of the timestamp, then calls validateSms on url_validate_sms.

items.topic: Helper route POST credit/GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName (checkout phone gate)
items.detail: Magento /mavi-monedero/.../phoneValidateSecretName calls it with {Cliente, uen} before the SMS step. LAN returns is_client_valid, secret_name, current_validated_phone, is_phone_validated, phone_validated and is_first_purchase. NombreCliente: dbo.FNVTASValidarEmpleado(@Cliente) (employees rejected), then Cte JOIN CteEnviarA with ID IN (3,76) for uen 1 or (7), Categoria 'CREDITO MENUDEO', Estatus 'ALTA'; names are masked. IsPhoneValidatedSecretPhone: SELECT TOP 1 ISNULL(Lada,'')+Telefono FROM ctetel WHERE Tipo='Movil' AND ValidacionTel=1 AND Cliente='{0}' ORDER BY id_tel DESC. This is string.Format and uses a different ordering from getSms's ORDER BY Fecha. is_phone_validated = phone present AND IsInTableStd (TablaStD 'ORIGEN VALIDACION NUMERO CTE' joined on CteTel.AppOrigen). IsFirstPurchase reads Venta/MovTipo VTAS.F Concluido. The browser uses these flags to choose validateUser or validateUserNewNumber. The DMZ still sends this route to LAN; ServicioSAP has no equivalent.

items.topic: Response mapping and error handling (DMZ + Magento)
items.detail: DMZ getSms: "0" → 400 'Error de credenciales'; "1" → 400 'Error de telefono'; "3" → 200 'Correcto'; "err" or other (-1) → 400 with no message. DMZ validateSms: "5" → 200 'Correcto'; "6" → 400 'Error de credenciales'; other → 400. Magento validateResponseIntelisis: HTTP 200 → 'Correcto'; 'Error de credenciales' → 401 'Número de cuenta inválida' (getSms) or 'Codigo de SMS no válido' (validate); 'Error de telefono' → 401 'aún no cuenta con un teléfono validado'. For any other Message the default branch runs `new WebapiException(...)` without throw, so the call returns null. Effects: (a) a missing validated phone surfaces as 'Número de cuenta inválida', because LAN returns 0, not 1; (b) SendSmsNewNumber result -1 still comes back as HTTP 200 and Magento treats it as success. Logging: the DMZ logs each request to Logger.Credit. LAN logs go to C:\inetpub\wwwroot\log: credit.log (INFO result, InsertCodigoVerificacion errors), setOrder.log (VTASCodigoSMSEcommerce/SendSmsNewNumber errors) and customerService.log (GetIdRef errors). ProductosCredito_Clave does not log. The logMessage built at ProductosCredito_Nip is unused.

items.topic: What happens after a successful validation
items.detail: Nothing server-side in LAN. validateSms only returns 5: no CteTel update (ValidacionTel), no new CteTel row, and no change to the code row. Magento saves omnipro_credito_sms and sets the session CuentaIntelisis. The browser then calls placeOrder. OrderMethods.UpdateSetNoValidated (UPDATE CteTel SET ValidacionTel=0 by Cliente and by CONCAT(Lada,Telefono)) exists but has no callers (dead code). The phone becomes relevant only when the credit order is created (next two items).

items.topic: How the credit order reads the SMS data (LAN OrderMethods)
items.detail: SetPedido, credit branch: numeroDelSms = ObtenerNumeroTablaSms(infoCliente.cuenta). ObtenerNumeroTablaSms: SELECT TOP 1 Telefono FROM TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes WHERE IdRegistro IN (SELECT IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce FROM VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce WHERE Cliente='{0}') ORDER BY Id DESC (string.Format; any cart, any IdMensaje). numeroValidado = IsValidated(cuenta): SELECT TOP 1 CONCAT(Lada,Telefono) FROM CteTel WHERE Cliente='{0}' AND Tipo='Movil' AND ValidacionTel=1 ORDER BY Fecha DESC. isValidated = numeroValidado == numeroDelSms. ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData receives numeroDelSms, or numeroValidado when the SMS phone is empty, plus isValidated. It splits the lada: 2 digits if the phone starts with 33/55/81, otherwise 3. It passes @LadaValidar, @TelefonoValidar and @ValidacionTelefono = (!isValidated || !IsInTableStd(cliente)) ? 1 : 0 to SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS @Op='Insert'. @lada_celular/@telefono_celular come from the order phone datosped[21].

items.topic: SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS use of the SMS phone
items.detail: Params @ValidacionTelefono BIT, @LadaValidar INT, @TelefonoValidar VARCHAR(10); locals @ValidacionOrigen, @TelefonoValidado, @TelefonoAValidar VARCHAR(10). In the Insert branch: @ValidacionOrigen = TablaStD 'ORIGEN VALIDACION NUMERO CTE' joined on CteTel.AppOrigen with ValidacionTel=1. @TelefonoValidado = newest CONCAT(Lada,Telefono) from CteTel with Tipo 'Movil' and ValidacionTel=1. @TelefonoAValidar = SELECT TOP 1 Telefono FROM TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes WHERE Cliente=@cliente ORDER BY Id DESC (no IdMensaje filter). If @TelefonoValidado IS NULL OR @ValidacionOrigen IS NULL OR they differ, @ValidacionTelefono = 1 unless the client starts with 'P' (then 0); otherwise 0. This overwrites the value sent by C#. The row goes to CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP columns ValidacionTelefono, LadaValidar, TelefonoValidar. items.topic: Robustness defects in the LAN flow (parity vs fix decisions)
items.detail: SQL built with string.Format and no parameters: GetIdRef (cliente, idCarrito), the SendSmsNewNumber INSERT (Cliente, NumeroTelefono), ObtenerNumeroTablaSms, IsValidated, IsPhoneValidatedSecretPhone. maps.summary: ServicioSAP has one SMS route, and it is wired: POST credit/SendSmsNewNumber (CreditController.cs:16-24 → CreditMethods.SendSmsNewNumberAsync :117-156). It is a near-exact port of LAN SendSmsNewNumber. The DMZ forwards it to SAP through curl.PostSAP, committed in c7d1d29 on 2026-08-10; whether that is deployed has no evidence. There is NO equivalent of LAN credit/getSms (ProductosCredito_Nip → VTASCodigoSMSEcommerce) or credit/validateSms (ProductosCredito_Clave → SP SPVTASCodigoSeguridadeCommerce @Op='CODIGO'). The DMZ still sends both to LAN with curl.Post (DMZ CreditController.cs:76,107). Two pieces can be reused but are private static: GetIdRefAsync and InsertCodigoVerificacionAsync (CreditMethods.cs:158-228). The credit flow reads the SMS data in two places, both in ServicioAndroid through MAVICBOSANDROID, and both use infoCliente.cuenta (meant to be the BP) as the customer key. (a) OrderMethods.ObtenerNumeroTablaSmsAsync (:589-613) takes TOP 1 Telefono from TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes where IdRegistro is in the IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce values of VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce with Cliente=@Cliente, ORDER BY Id DESC. It swallows errors and returns "". (b) SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.ObtenerTelefonoAValidarAsync (:333-370) takes TOP 1 Telefono from TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes where Cliente=@cliente, ORDER BY Id DESC. It rethrows errors. So a port must write both tables with Cliente = the exact cuenta string, and set EnvioMensajes.IdRegistro = VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce.IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce. Web.config has no SMS or provider key. LAN has none either: SMS is sent by a modem process that reads TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes. The route conventions to follow are: class-level [Authorize] plus [RoutePrefix("credit")], attribute routes, JWT checked by the global TokenValidationHandler, Ok(...) responses, and Logger.SAP("[AREA Method ERROR] ", msg). For setOrder the error rule is "return 200 plus log" (OrderController.cs:37-47).

items.topic: (1) Existing SMS route: credit/SendSmsNewNumber (wired, compiled)
items.detail: CreditController has class-level [Authorize] and [RoutePrefix("credit")]. The action is [HttpPost][Route("SendSmsNewNumber")] async Task<IHttpActionResult> SendSmsNewNumber(SendSmsNewNumberRequest). Its only guard is request==null → BadRequest("Datos incompletos."); otherwise it returns Ok(await CreditMethods.SendSmsNewNumberAsync(request)), and the body is {"result": n}. Request model: Cliente, NumeroTelefono, IdCarrito (strings) and EsCredito (bool). The csproj compiles Controllers\CreditController.cs (:221), Methods\Credit\CreditMethods.cs (:256) and Models\SAP\Credit\SendSmsNewNumberRequest.cs (:373). This route is not getSms/validateSms. It is LAN's 'Remover NIP' region route (LAN Controllers\CreditController.cs:538-552).

items.topic: (1) SendSmsNewNumberAsync: what it writes
items.detail: Step 1: NumeroTelefono = Regex.Replace(NumeroTelefono, "[^0-9]", ""). This runs outside the try (:119), so a null NumeroTelefono gives a 500, as in LAN. Step 2: open obtenerConexionAndroidAsync (MAVICBOSANDROID → ServicioAndroid). Step 3: idRef = GetIdRefAsync(Cliente, IdCarrito); if idRef == "0" or empty, idRef = InsertCodigoVerificacionAsync(...); if it is still empty, return {result:-1}. Step 4: IdMensaje is 23 with Identificador 'DM0363' when EsCredito, otherwise 60 with 'DM0312'. Step 5: INSERT INTO TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes (IdRegistro, IdMensaje, Cliente, FechaEnvio, EstatusEnvio, ClienteF, Tipo, IntentoRespuesta, IntentoEnvio, Modem, Identificador, Telefono) VALUES (idRef, IdMensaje, 'Cliente', GETDATE(), 1, NULL, 0, 0, 0, NULL, 'Identificador', 'Telefono'). The values are built with string.Format, not parameters: this is an SQL injection risk, inherited from LAN. Step 6: return {result: rowsAffected}. On any exception it calls Logger.SAP("[CREDIT SendSmsNewNumber ERROR] ") and returns {result:-1}. Cliente is written unchanged: no C↔BP translation.

items.topic: (1) Reusable helpers GetIdRefAsync / InsertCodigoVerificacionAsync (private static)
items.detail: GetIdRefAsync runs SELECT ISNULL(MAX(IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce), '') AS IdRef FROM VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE Cliente = '{0}' AND IdCarrito = '{1}'. It uses string.Format, and IdCarrito is quoted; LAN leaves it unquoted (LAN CreditMethods.cs:2045). It does not filter on FechaExpira or Estatus, so an expired code can be reused, as in LAN. On an exception it logs "[CREDIT GetIdRef ERROR] " and returns "". InsertCodigoVerificacionAsync runs a parameterized INSERT INTO VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce (Cliente, Codigo, IdCarrito, FechaRegristro, FechaExpira, Estatus) VALUES (@Cliente, RIGHT('000000' + CAST(ABS(CHECKSUM(NEWID())) % 1000000 AS VARCHAR(6)), 6), @IdCarrito, GETDATE(), DATEADD(MINUTE, 2, GETDATE()), 1), then calls GetIdRefAsync again. This matches LAN (CreditMethods.cs:2067-2100). Both helpers are private, so a getSms/validateSms port has to live in CreditMethods or have their visibility changed.

items.topic: (1) Parity of SendSmsNewNumber vs LAN
items.detail: Differences from LAN: (a) ServicioSAP inserts a new code when idRef == "0" OR is empty (:126); LAN only checks == "0" (LAN :2000). An empty idRef only happens when GetIdRef throws, because MAX always returns a row. (b) IdCarrito is quoted in the WHERE. (c) Errors go to Logger.SAP; LAN uses Logger.SetOrder, CustomerService and Credit. (d) ExecuteNonQuery is used where LAN uses ExecuteReader().RecordsAffected. The contract (verb, route, model, {result:n}, -1 on failure) is the same. The DMZ model adds EsCredito defaulting to true and a Codigo field (DMZ Models\CreditRequest.cs:168-176).

items.topic: (1) getSms / validateSms: not present in ServicioSAP
items.detail: There is no Route("getSms") or Route("validateSms") in any ServicioSAP controller. A grep of ServicioSAP finds nothing for SPVTASCodigoSeguridadeCommerce, VTASCodigoSMSEcommerce, GetSmsStatus, GetVerificationCode, InsertSendingSms, ExistingCustomer, UpdateMagentoId or GetValidatedPhoneNumber. What LAN does, for reference. getSms: NipRequest {cuenta, idCarritoCliente, cliente} → ProductosCredito_Nip(cuenta, int.Parse(idCarritoCliente), int.Parse(cliente)=idMagento) → VTASCodigoSMSEcommerce, which does: UPDATE Intelisis Cte.IDMagento; ExistingCustomer(Cte); GetIdRef; GetValidatedPhoneNumber (CteTel Movil, ValidacionTel=1, LEN(Lada)+LEN(Tel)=10, ORDER BY Fecha DESC); InsertCodigoVerificacion; GetSmsStatus (EnvioMensajes where IdMensaje=23: 1 → return 3, 2/3 → re-insert the code); InsertSendingSms (IdMensaje 23, 'DM0363', validated phone). Return codes: 0 = no customer/nothing sent, 1 = no phone, 3 = sent, 'err' = exception. validateSms: ClaveRequest {cuenta, claveSms, idCarritoCliente} → SP SPVTASCodigoSeguridadeCommerce with @Op='CODIGO' on ServicioAndroid. It returns 5 when a row exists in VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce with Cliente=@Cliente, IdCarrito=@IdCarrito and Codigo=@CodigoWeb, otherwise 6. It does not check FechaExpira or Estatus. On an exception it returns e.Message.

items.topic: (1) DMZ wiring of the three routes
items.detail: getSms uses curl.Post("credit/getSms") and then .Trim('"'). The base URL is AppSettings URL_INTELISIS, i.e. LAN (DMZ Helper\Curl.cs:22,106). The DMZ maps the codes to HTTP: "0" → 400 'Error de credenciales', "1" → 400 'Error de telefono', "3" → 200 'Correcto', 'err' or anything else → 400. validateSms uses curl.Post("credit/validateSms") with the same Trim: "5" → 200 'Correcto', "6" → 400 'Error de credenciales', anything else → 400. SendSmsNewNumber uses curl.PostSAP (URL_SAP, Curl.cs:23,127) → Ok(JsonConvert.DeserializeObject(response)). It was committed in c7d1d29 on 2026-08-10 ('Cutover a SAP de credit/SendSmsNewNumber (E-01)'), branch ConexionSAP, and the file is clean in the working tree. A port has to return the same bare string codes, because the DMZ trims the quotes from Ok(string).

items.topic: (2) Reader A: OrderMethods.ObtenerNumeroTablaSmsAsync
items.detail: Exact SQL on obtenerConexionAndroidAsync: "SELECT TOP 1 Telefono FROM TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE IdRegistro IN (SELECT IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce FROM VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce CV WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CV.Cliente = @Cliente) ORDER BY Id DESC", with @Cliente as SqlDbType.VarChar = cliente ?? "", CommandTimeout 99999 and ExecuteScalar. Filters: the customer is matched only through VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce.Cliente (not EnvioMensajes.Cliente). There is no IdCarrito, IdMensaje, EstatusEnvio or date filter, and the newest EnvioMensajes.Id wins. On an error it only does Console.WriteLine and returns "" (runbook B7). It is called with sDatosPedido[36] (:1804). In ToArray, [36] = order.infoCliente?.cuenta ?? "" (:288, documented at :196). The result is the first priority for telAux (:688), split into lada (2 digits when the number starts with 33/55/81, otherwise 3) and number (:689-691), and written to LadaValidar/TelefonoValidar (:838-839). This is the same query as LAN OrderMethods.cs:827-829.

items.topic: (2) Reader B: SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.ObtenerTelefonoAValidarAsync
items.detail: Exact SQL on obtenerConexionAndroidAsync: "SELECT TOP 1 Telefono FROM TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE Cliente = @cliente ORDER BY Id DESC", with @cliente as SqlDbType.VarChar and CommandTimeout 99999. It returns null when there is no row. On an error it logs "[CREDIT ObtenerTelefonoAValidar ERROR] " and RETHROWS (:368), which aborts InsertAsync. Filters: only EnvioMensajes.Cliente; there is no join to VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce and no IdMensaje or EstatusEnvio filter. It is only called when TelefonoValidado (A_GET_TelefonoValidado on URL_BP_API) is not null (:389-401). The result is cut to 10 characters and compared with TelefonoValidado in ResolverValidacionTelefono (:315-331). The customer id is req.Cliente (InsertAsync :25-27), which OrderMethods sets to info.cuenta ?? "" (OrderMethods.cs:825). This mirrors SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:204-208.

items.topic: (2) Write contract the port must satisfy
items.detail: For both readers to see the SMS number, getSms/SendSmsNewNumber must write the following. (a) A VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce row with Cliente = exactly the infoCliente.cuenta string that later reaches order/new. OrderMethods names it cuentaBp (:669) and checks it against SAP with GetClientAsync (:681, :768-781), so it is the 10-digit BP. (b) A TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes row with IdRegistro = that row's IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce, Cliente = the same string, and Telefono = digits only (reader B cuts to 10; reader A splits the lada by the 33/55/81 prefix). Because neither reader filters on IdMensaje, rows with 23/DM0363 and with 60/DM0312 both count. For a new client, cuenta is empty, so both readers query Cliente='' (OrderMethods.cs:672,1804; runbook B4). Column widths come only from a document, not from DDL: E-01 states that Cliente is varchar(10) in both tables, which leaves no margin for a 10-digit BP.

items.topic: (1)/(2) SAP-side equivalents already in ServicioSAP for getSms's Intelisis steps
items.detail: ExistingCustomer (Intelisis Cte) maps to BusinessPartnerMethods.GetClientAsync: ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE_CDS/ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE?$filter=BusinessPartner eq '{id}'&$top=1 (:27-30). The first is IsValidatedAsync → GetClientMaAsync (ZAPI_BP05MA_SRV BusinessPartnerSet with $expand=to_CteTel), filtering Zvaltel, ZappOrig not blank, ZtelCte not blank and ZtipoCte='MOVIL'. It does not order by Zfecha (OrderMethods.cs:631-660), even though BusinessPhone exposes ZidcteTel, ZtipoCte, ZtelCte, Zfecha, Zenvionip, Zvaltel, ZappOrig, ZfechaCap, ZtelExist, ZtraeTel, Zintentos and ZtipoValid (BusinessEntitiesMa.cs:5-21). The second is GetTelefonoValidadoAsync → URL_BP_API /A_GET_TelefonoValidado?sCliente= (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:480-523). The runbook's Q4 recommends one helper using LAN's rule (:1862). UpdateMagentoId (Cte.IDMagento) maps to LinkMagentoAccountAsync, a PATCH to ZSDT_CTE_ODATA_SRV/ZSDT_CTE_ENTITYSet(ZclienteBp='{bp}') with {ZidMagento} and X-CSRF-Token (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:833-873). It is exposed as PATCH partner/client/unircuenta (BusinessPartnerController.cs:77-96).

items.topic: (4) Routing and JWT conventions
items.detail: WebApiConfig registers config.MapHttpAttributeRoutes() and config.MessageHandlers.Add(new TokenValidationHandler()). The handler validates the Bearer JWT against JWT_SECRET_KEY, JWT_AUDIENCE_TOKEN and JWT_ISSUER_TOKEN and sets the principal; when the Authorization header is missing it passes the request through, so [Authorize] rejects it. Every business controller uses class-level [Authorize] plus [RoutePrefix(...)]; only LoginController is [AllowAnonymous]. New routes belong in CreditController ([RoutePrefix("credit")], :9-10) as [HttpPost][Route("getSms")] / [Route("validateSms")] public async Task<IHttpActionResult>, with logic in static CreditMethods and .ConfigureAwait(false). AbonosController also uses RoutePrefix("credit"), but its routes (GetAccountDebts, getClienteFactura/{cliente}/{factura}, ApplyPaymentNeko, UpdateStatusPaymentNeko, GetCobrosReferenciados/{bp}, GetClabeSTP/{bp}) do not collide.

items.topic: (4) Response style and error rule
items.detail: Null body: OrderController throws HttpResponseException(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest) (:20-23), which is also LAN's getSms/validateSms behaviour (LAN CreditController.cs:28-29,50-51); CreditController uses BadRequest("Datos incompletos.") (:20-21). Success is Ok(value). The '200 + log' rule is OrderController.SetOrder's catch: Logger.SAP("[ORDER NEW ERROR] ", $"incrementId=... :: {e}") followed by return Ok("Error, " + e.Message). The code comment explains it: LAN returned 200 even on failure, and the DMZ forwards the response as is. Other credit routes differ: GetPlazos and GetCondicionesPago → InternalServerError; GetCreditAmounts → Logger.SAP plus a thrown 500; SaveImagesProductosMx → Logger.SAP plus Ok(false). LAN parity for getSms/validateSms: the methods return code strings ("err" in ProductosCredito_Nip :42-46, e.Message in ProductosCredito_Clave :87-90), and the controller turns thrown exceptions into 500s (LAN CreditController.cs:38-41,60-63).

items.topic: (4) Logger.SAP usage
items.detail: Signature: Logger.SAP(string type, string message). It appends '[yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss] ' + type + message to C:\inetpub\wwwroot\log\sap.log (only if that folder exists) and to <AppDomain BaseDirectory>\Logs\sap.log, and writes to Debug. Tag convention: "[CREDIT <Method> ERROR] " (CreditMethods.cs:111,153,186,225). Directory.CreateDirectory runs outside the try (Logger.cs:28-31; runbook B8). The two readers are inconsistent: ObtenerNumeroTablaSmsAsync logs only to Console (OrderMethods.cs:610), while ObtenerTelefonoAValidarAsync uses Logger.SAP (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:366).
