maps.summary:
The NIP SMS chain is Magento (Omnipro_MaviCredito PHP plus two KO JS components) → DMZ WebApiMagento CreditController (getSms/validateSms) → LAN WebApiMagento, which returns bare codes. DMZ reaches LAN through Curl.Post and the URL_INTELISIS key; the SAP routes use Curl.PostSAP and URL_SAP. DMZ changes both the request and the response. Magento never sees LAN's numeric codes. It only sees DMZ's HTTP 200 "Correcto", 400 {"Message":"Error de credenciales"|"Error de telefono"}, or a 400 with an empty body.

ServicioSAP must expose POST credit/getSms and POST credit/validateSms under [Authorize]. They must accept DMZ's re-serialized all-string bodies and always answer HTTP 200 with a JSON string code: getSms "3"/"0"/"1"/other, validateSms "5"/"6"/other. Any non-200 response gets flattened by DMZ into a generic "connection error". Neither route exists in ServicioSAP yet. On the DMZ side the only change needed is Post→PostSAP at CreditController.cs:76 and :107, the same pattern SendSmsNewNumber already uses at :308. The JWT settings match between LAN and ServicioSAP, so auth is not a blocker.

Magento can only send Intelisis accounts today, because its JS checks the account against /C\d{8}/. So ServicioSAP must accept "C########" in `cuenta` until Magento sends BPs. It must also key the verification rows the same way the already-ported SendSmsNewNumber does, because validateSms has to validate codes created by both getSms and SendSmsNewNumber.

Two pre-existing hazards: (a) a probable second caller of validateSms, Mavi_JoinAccount, which sends a synthetic idCarritoCliente that can overflow int32 with LAN's int.Parse; (b) a Magento defect that likely turns a DMZ 500 (for example, the DMZ Curl constructor failing its ServicioSAP login) into a "success" that places the order. The configured Magento endpoint URLs are not in the repo, so "Magento calls DMZ credit/getSms" is inferred from matching payload shapes and message strings, not proven.

items.topic: Magento REST entry points (what the browser calls)
items.detail: Magento exposes anonymous POST routes /V1/omnipro-credito/validateUser, /getSms, /validateSms and /validateUserNewNumber, all on Omnipro\MaviCredito\Api\CreditoManagementInterface. Signatures: getSms($account,$nip,$cart_id,$guest,$customer_id=0), validateUser(...,$same_as_validated=false), validateSms($account,$sms_code,$guest,$cart_id); all return string. No JS in app/code or app/design calls /rest/V1/omnipro-credito/getSms (the grep only hits webapi.xml). The storefront requests the SMS through validateUser, which posts to the same backend endpoint (sms_endpoint) as getSms.

items.topic: JS step 1 - request the NIP SMS (payment step)
items.detail: The flow is placeOrderCredito → placeOrderFunction. For a 'client' it only proceeds if account() matches /C\d{8}/i; otherwise it shows the error 'El campo cliente no es valido'. If clientValidated() is false it calls sendSmsCode, which POSTs to /rest/V1/omnipro-credito/validateUserNewNumber (new or different phone) or else /rest/V1/omnipro-credito/validateUser. Payload: {account, nip:"0000" (hard-coded), cart_id: quote.getQuoteId() (a masked id for guests), guest: !customer.isLoggedIn(), new_phone, customer_id (only when logged in), same_as_validated (only when the phone equals the validated one)}. The response body is not read. On done: clientValidated(true), then placeOrderFunction → placeOrder. On fail: a generic 'Ha ocurrido un error, vuelve a intentarlo más tarde', and the specific backend message is dropped. Side note (inference): line 757 tests self.newPhoneNumber.length on a KO observable, i.e. the function's arity, not the phone text.

items.topic: JS precondition - which phone and which route
items.detail: When the account changes, JS POSTs {client: account} to /rest/V1/mavi-monedero/(customer|guest/:cartId)/phoneValidateSecretName. That PHP call posts {Cliente, uen} to config url_get_validate_secret_name and reads secret_name, phone_validated, is_first_purchase, is_client_valid and current_validated_phone. isPhoneValidated/isNewPhoneNumber decide between validateUser (getSms path) and validateUserNewNumber (SendSmsNewNumber path). The DMZ counterpart, credit/GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName, still goes to LAN via curl.Post, and ServicioSAP has no such route (grep for GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName/phone_validated: 0 hits). For parity, the phone that getSms texts should be the one this route reports as validated.

items.topic: JS step 1 → step 2 hand-off
items.detail: placeOrder calls set-payment-information. It then stores creditData {customer_credit_account, customer_credit_is_new_phone, customer_credit_same_as_validated, customer_credit_phone, customer_credit_is_phone_validated, customer_credit_phone_secret:'******'+last 4} in sessionStorage 'mavi_credit_data', and for 'client' POSTs a form (payload=creditData, form_key) to /creditocheckout. Guests go to /productosmx instead, which is a different NIP flow (see the ProductosMX item).

items.topic: JS step 2 - validate the NIP (credit checkout page)
items.detail: Component Mavi_CreditoCheckout/credito-checkout-functions.js. On init it sets customerAccount = allData.customer_credit_account and calls startTimer(). validateSms(): if tries()>=3 it shows 'Has alcanzado el limite de intentos' and stops. Otherwise it POSTs /rest/V1/omnipro-credito/validateSms {account, sms_code: smsCode(), cart_id: quote.getQuoteId(), guest: !is_logged_in, is_validated, is_new_number}. The last two are not in the PHP signature. On done it ignores the body: with a promoter code it places the order only if the code is 'Código válido', otherwise it calls placeOrder() (set-payment-information → /rest/V1/omnipro-credito/requestCreditOrder {quoteId} → saveHistory → /creditocheckout/onepage/success). On fail it re-enables the button, does tries++, and shows response.responseJSON.message. UI: SMS input maxlength 8, alphanumeric only; 'Intento N de 3'; masked phone from customerSecretPhone.

items.topic: JS resend and timers
items.detail: timerValue starts at 300 s, and startTimer runs on page init, counting down every 1 s. At 0 it sets canSendSms(true). reSendSms is refused before then ('Tienes que esperar mm:ss ...'). It re-POSTs validateUserNewNumber (if customerIsNewPhone && sameAsValidated) or validateUser with the same payload shape as step 1 (nip "0000"). On done it resets the timer to 300, sets canSendSms(false), restarts the timer and sets tries(0). On fail it shows a generic error. The 3-try limit is client-side only and resets on every resend. The server-side limit is commented out, and CreditoManagement::LIMIT=5 is unused (no self::LIMIT reference). The theme file checkout-data-resolver.js is a byte-identical copy of lines 139-260 (same template). The legacy omnipro_pago_credito_form.html (validateSms button) is not used: the renderer loads omnipro_pago_credito-form, remapped to Mavi_LeyendaClienteNuevo.

items.topic: Magento PHP → backend: getSms / validateUser request
items.detail: URL = config omnipro_intelisisintegration/mavi_credito/sms_endpoint (Helper getSmsEndpoint). For guests, quoteId comes from quote_id_mask(masked_id), otherwise quoteId = cart_id. Body JSON is {cuenta: $account, idCarritoCliente: $quoteId, cliente: $customer_id}; customer_id defaults to int 0 for guests. $nip is NOT sent. getSms upserts omnipro_credito_sms (cuenta, quote_id, intentos_sms++) and saves it inside validateResponseIntelisis. validateUser calls first, then saves the row with intentos_sms=1 and sets session IsNewPhoneNumber. For non-guests, both write customer attribute customer_temp_cash_account = account.

items.topic: Magento PHP → backend: validateSms request
items.detail: validateSms needs an existing omnipro_credito_sms row for the quote; otherwise it throws WebapiException 'No existe una solicitud para este carrito'. It sets customer session CuentaIntelisis=$account, increments intentos_validate_sms, then POSTs to config mavi_credito/validate_sms_endpoint the body {cuenta, claveSms: $sms_code, idCarritoCliente: $quoteId}.

items.topic: Magento PHP - how it reads the backend (DMZ) response
items.detail: validateResponseIntelisis: if status==200 it returns 'Correcto' and ignores the body entirely. Otherwise it json_decodes the body and reads 'Message'. 'Error de credenciales' → WebapiException 401, with 'Número de cuenta inválida' (getSms) or 'Codigo de SMS no válido' (validate). 'Error de telefono' → 401 'No es posible concluir la compra porque aún no cuenta con un teléfono validado...'. No Message (for example an empty 400 body) or no body → WebapiException 'Ha ocurrido un error de conexión, por favor intente más tarde'. DEFECT: for any other Message the default case builds a WebapiException but never throws it (line 330), so the method returns null. Inference: Magento REST then answers 2xx, and the JS done-branch runs, so validateSms would place the order. The Adapter adds 'Authorization: Bearer <token>', gets the token from config general/endpoint_token, and returns ['status','body']. If there is no token it returns false, which leads to the connection-error message.

items.topic: Second probable caller of validateSms: Mavi_JoinAccount
items.detail: postApiValidarSMS POSTs {cuenta, claveSms, idCarritoCliente} to config url_validate_sms and succeeds only if status===200 AND the body with quotes stripped === 'Correcto'. That is the same payload shape as credit/validateSms. Its send step (postApiSendSMS) uses the SendSmsNewNumber shape {Cliente, NumeroTelefono, IdCarrito, EsCredito:false} to url_send_sms and needs body.result===1. IdCarrito is synthetic: customer_id plus the last 4 timestamp digits. With LAN's int.Parse(idCarritoCliente) this overflows int32 for customer_id ≥ 214749, which gives a 500, then DMZ BadRequest(), then false.

items.topic: Adjacent route already on ServicioSAP: SendSmsNewNumber
items.detail: Magento validateUserNewNumber posts {Cliente: account, NumeroTelefono: new_phone, IdCarrito: quoteId} to config get_sms_number_novalidated_endpoint. DMZ credit/SendSmsNewNumber relays it with PostSAP. The DMZ model defaults EsCredito=true and adds Codigo. ServicioSAP SendSmsNewNumberAsync gets or inserts a VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce row keyed by (Cliente as received, IdCarrito), inserts TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes (IdMensaje 23/DM0363 for credit), and returns {"result": n}. Magento only checks HTTP 200, so result=-1 still reads as 'Correcto'. Consequence for the port: the same credit/validateSms must accept codes created here AND by getSms, so all three must use the same Cliente key and the same table.

items.topic: DMZ relay: credit/getSms
items.detail: The controller has [Authorize] and RoutePrefix 'credit'. POST getSms binds NipRequest {cuenta, nipCliente, idCarritoCliente, cliente}, all strings, so JSON numbers from PHP become strings. It logs the request and throws 400 (empty body) if the body is null. It then re-serializes the DMZ model with JsonConvert: all four keys, 'nipCliente':null included because Magento never sends it. That is sent with curl.Post("credit/getSms") to URL_INTELISIS, and the result is Trim('"')'d. The response is transformed: "3" → 200 Ok("Correcto"); "0" → 400 BadRequest("Error de credenciales") (body {"Message":...}); "1" → 400 "Error de telefono"; "err" or anything else → 400 BadRequest() with an empty body.

items.topic: DMZ relay: credit/validateSms
items.detail: POST validateSms binds ClaveRequest {cuenta, claveSms, idCarritoCliente}, all strings. It logs the whole request, so the SMS code ends up in the DMZ log in clear. A null body gives 400. The request goes out with curl.Post("credit/validateSms") to URL_INTELISIS and the result is Trim('"')'d. Mapping: "5" → 200 Ok("Correcto"); "6" → 400 {"Message":"Error de credenciales"}; "err" or anything else → 400 with an empty body. DMZ never forwards the backend's HTTP status or body to Magento.

items.topic: DMZ Curl helper - backend selection, auth and error flattening
items.detail: Post() uses Ip = AppSettings URL_INTELISIS; PostSAP()/GetSAP()/PatchSAP() use IpSAP = URL_SAP. The constructor always logs in at IpSAP + 'login/auth' with USER_SAP and sets Token = TokenSAP, so since 2026-06-26 even legacy Post() calls carry the ServicioSAP token. If that login fails, the constructor rethrows. That gives an unhandled 500 {"Message":"An error has occurred."}, which falls into Magento's non-throwing default case (see the Magento response item). Post() returns e.ToString() on any exception, including non-2xx from the backend. PostSAP returns 'WebException: ... Body: ...'. Either way a non-200 backend reply cannot match '3'/'5'/'0'/'6', so it becomes 400 with an empty body, i.e. the connection-error message in Magento.

items.topic: DMZ config: where Post vs PostSAP go
items.detail: DMZ Web.config is gitignored, so only the shared working copy is known (keys and hosts only). Line 16 (commented): URL_INTELISIS → kdll3fhcyo-lan.grupomavi.com, base /api/ (LAN). Line 17 (active): URL_INTELISIS → https://localhost:44399/. Line 18 (active): URL_SAP → kdll3fhcyo-lan.grupomavi.com, base /SAP/. Line 19 (commented): URL_SAP → localhost:44399. Port 44399 is ServicioSAP's IIS Express port (LAN is 44303/44302, DMZ is 44302). So in this working copy, DMZ getSms/validateSms already hit a local ServicioSAP, which has no such routes; that means 404 → 400 empty → connection error. Web.Debug/Web.Release have no transforms for these keys.

items.topic: Auth between DMZ and either backend
items.detail: JWT_SECRET_KEY, JWT_ISSUER_TOKEN and JWT_AUDIENCE_TOKEN are identical in LAN Web.config and ServicioSAP Web.config (compared by hash; values not printed). So the ServicioSAP token that DMZ now sends is valid on both, and switching getSms/validateSms to ServicioSAP needs no auth change. The ServicioSAP token route is login/auth, and ServicioSAP CreditController has [Authorize].

items.topic: LAN contract being replaced (what DMZ receives today)
items.detail: LAN POST credit/getSms returns Ok(cm.ProductosCredito_Nip(cuenta, int.Parse(idCarritoCliente), int.Parse(cliente))). int.Parse sits inside the try, so a failure throws 500, which DMZ turns into 400 empty. The code comes from VTASCodigoSMSEcommerce: 3 = SMS queued or already pending; 0 = not an existing customer, or no validated phone (it falls through to return 0); -1 = exception. It never returns 1, so DMZ's 'Error de telefono' branch is unreachable today and 'no validated phone' surfaces as 'Número de cuenta inválida'. ProductosCredito_Nip returns 'err' only from its own catch. LAN POST credit/validateSms returns Ok(ProductosCredito_Clave(cuenta, claveSms, int.Parse(idCarritoCliente))): the retValue of SPVTASCodigoSeguridadeCommerce @Op='CODIGO' (5 = accepted, 6 = mismatch), or e.Message on exception. Both answer HTTP 200 with a JSON string, e.g. "3". The LAN models have no nipCliente.

items.topic: Exact contract ServicioSAP must keep (Magento and DMZ unchanged)
items.detail: (1) Routes: POST {URL_SAP}credit/getSms and POST {URL_SAP}credit/validateSms under the existing [Authorize][RoutePrefix("credit")] CreditController. These names are free in both CreditController and AbonosController. (2) Request, Content-Type application/json, every value a JSON string: getSms {"cuenta":"C########","nipCliente":null,"idCarritoCliente":"<quote id>","cliente":"<magento customer id or 0>"}, where nipCliente is ignored and cliente>0 triggers LAN's UpdateMagentoId equivalent. validateSms {"cuenta","claveSms" (≤8 alphanumeric),"idCarritoCliente"}. (3) Response: always HTTP 200 with a JSON string body (Ok(string); default JSON formatter; DMZ trims the quotes). No objects, no {"result":..} like SendSmsNewNumber, no 4xx/5xx for business outcomes. getSms: "3" = sent, "0" = invalid account or no validated phone (LAN parity), "1" = no phone (optional, never emitted by LAN), "-1"/"err" = failure. validateSms: "5" = match, "6" = mismatch or expired, anything else = failure. (4) Keep LAN's int32 parse semantics for idCarritoCliente/cliente, or consciously widen them (JoinAccount overflow). (5) What Magento finally shows: 200 'Correcto'; 401 'Número de cuenta inválida' or 'Codigo de SMS no válido'; 401 phone message; 400 'Ha ocurrido un error de conexión'.

items.topic: What DMZ must change to point at ServicioSAP
items.detail: Minimal change: CreditController.cs:76 curl.Post("credit/getSms", ...) → curl.PostSAP("credit/getSms", ...), and :107 curl.Post("credit/validateSms", ...) → curl.PostSAP(...). This is the same pattern already used for SendSmsNewNumber (:308) and getClienteFactura (:51). Keep the switch/.Trim('"') mapping, the models and the log lines as they are. PostSAP's different error string still falls into the default → BadRequest() path, so behavior is identical. No Magento change is needed while Magento keeps sending 'C' accounts. Not recommended: repointing URL_INTELISIS instead, because that moves every legacy curl.Post route at once. The working copy already does this with localhost:44399.

items.topic: Customer id: Intelisis 'C' account vs SAP BP
items.detail: Magento can only emit cuenta='C' + 8 digits: placeOrderFunction gates on /C\d{8}/i and the watcher uses /^C\d{8}$/. The value flows unchanged through DMZ. ServicioSAP SendSmsNewNumber stores request.Cliente as received in VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce/TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes, and ObtenerNumeroTablaSmsAsync reads those tables by Cliente. So until Magento sends BPs, getSms/validateSms must accept 'C########'. Resolve to a BP only where SAP data is needed (validated phone via the Q4 helper), and keep the ServicioAndroid key identical across getSms, SendSmsNewNumber and validateSms. The runbook's Q9 says: port with the Q4 helper before Magento sends BPs. Moving to 10-digit BPs would need Magento JS regex changes (and the Magento session CuentaIntelisis / customer_temp_cash_account consumers).

items.topic: Out of scope: other NIP flows that do NOT use credit/getSms
items.detail: ProductosMX (guest credit): the NIP is sent and validated through SaveFirstData with op 'SaveNip'/'ValNip' (the SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS path), and the code is kept in the custom session. JoinAccount's send uses the SendSmsNewNumber shape. Neither goes through DMZ getSms.

no_evidence: The configured values of Magento omnipro_intelisisintegration/mavi_credito/sms_endpoint, validate_sms_endpoint, get_sms_number_novalidated_endpoint and general/endpoint_token are not in app/etc or any module config.xml (they live in core_config_data). That Magento calls DMZ credit/getSms and credit/validateSms is inferred from matching field names and DMZ message strings, not proven.
The JoinAccount url_validate_sms and url_send_sms values (etc/config.xml:10-11 are empty), so it is not proven that JoinAccount calls DMZ credit/validateSms and credit/SendSmsNewNumber.
The deployed DMZ Web.config (gitignored). Only the shared working copy was seen, where URL_INTELISIS points to localhost:44399.
The DMZ IIS base path used by Magento, and whether Magento or any other client calls LAN or ServicioSAP directly without going through DMZ.
How Magento REST renders a null return from validateSms/validateUser (the non-throwing default case). A 2xx response, and therefore a JS success, is inferred, not verified.
When or whether Magento will switch `cuenta` from 'C########' to a 10-digit BP. A name search for a C-account→BP helper in ServicioSAP found nothing.
The magnitude of Magento customer_id values, so it is unknown whether the JoinAccount idCarritoCliente int32 overflow happens in practice.

Whether LAN's GetSmsStatus/InsertCodigoVerificacion enforce any server-side resend throttle beyond the branches at CreditMethods.cs:2116-2182. Not mapped here; this belongs to the business-logic analysis.

maps.summary: In LAN, the NIP SMS flow (credit/getSms → CreditMethods.VTASCodigoSMSEcommerce, credit/validateSms → SP SPVTASCodigoSeguridadeCommerce @Op='CODIGO') touches only three Intelisis objects. It reads Cte to check that the customer exists. It writes Cte.IDMagento. It reads CteTel for the newest validated 10-digit MOVIL phone. It never writes CteTel: it never marks a phone validated and never adds one. Every other access is to ServicioAndroid tables (VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce and TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes), and these stay as direct SQL. SAP-side equivalents and whether ServicioSAP already has them: (1) Cte existence → ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE_CDS through GetClientAsync, or the ZAPI_BP05MA_SRV key read through GetClientMaAsync. Both exist. (2) Cte.IDMagento → PATCH ZSDT_CTE_ODATA_SRV/ZSDT_CTE_ENTITYSet(ZclienteBp) {ZidMagento} with CSRF, through LinkMagentoAccountAsync. It exists, but sap.log shows no run of it. (3) CteTel validated phone → ZQBP_EDITARCLIENTE_SRV/CteTelSet?$filter=Partner eq '<BP>' (private GetCteTelAsync), or ZAPI_BP05MA_SRV to_CteTel. Both expose ZtipoCte, ZtelCte, Zvaltel, Zfecha, ZappOrig, Zenvionip, Zintentos, ZtipoValid and ZfechaCap. LAN's rule (MOVIL, validated, 10 digits, not '0', newest Zfecha) has to be applied in C#. None of the three existing lookups applies it: GetTelefonoValidadoAsync through A_GET_TelefonoValidado takes the newest phone of any type, and IsValidatedAsync adds a ZappOrig check and does not sort. This is the open Q4 helper. validateSms uses only ServicioAndroid. ServicioSAP already has GetIdRefAsync and InsertCodigoVerificacionAsync (both private) and the EnvioMensajes INSERT pattern in SendSmsNewNumberAsync. It is missing the read of the send status (EstatusEnvio), the read of the stored code, the resend insert with the same code, the fixed IdMensaje 23/DM0363 send insert, and the code check. businesspartner-dev writes CteTel with POST ZQBP CteTelSet (CSRF, next ZidcteTel = max+1), with PUT ZQBP CteTelSet(Partner,ZidcteTel), which is disabled in ServicioSAP, or with POST ZAPI_BP01_PARTNER_SRV/BPartnerSet + toCteTel. I found no evidence that CteTelSet accepts PATCH. ServicioSAP has no CteTelSet write method. SubmitClientInfoAsync is unsafe for a phone-only update because it always sends non-nullable booleans. For parity with LAN, the port should not write CteTel at all. Flagged risks: Cliente in the SMS tables becomes the 10-digit BP (the SP parameter is varchar(15); the table columns' DDL is not available), and the SMS sender SpAAea00030_ArmadoSMS is not in the corpus. Other Intelisis objects near the flow are not used by getSms/validateSms: TablaStd, NIPVenta, and the reads behind GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName (CteEnviarA, FNVTASValidarEmpleado, Venta).

items.topic: LAN contract of the two routes (what must be kept)
items.detail: POST credit/getSms takes NipRequest {cuenta, idCarritoCliente, cliente}. It calls ProductosCredito_Nip(cuenta, int.Parse(idCarritoCliente), int.Parse(cliente)) and returns a string code: '0', '3', '-1', or 'err' (only if logging throws). POST credit/validateSms takes ClaveRequest {cuenta, claveSms, idCarritoCliente}. It calls ProductosCredito_Clave and returns '5' or '6', or e.Message on an exception. The DMZ maps 0→'Error de credenciales', 1→'Error de telefono', 3→'Correcto', 5→'Correcto', 6→'Error de credenciales', anything else→400. Magento sends cuenta=account, idCarritoCliente=quoteId, cliente=Magento customer_id (0 for guests). Magento does NOT send the NIP.

items.topic: LAN getSms algorithm (VTASCodigoSMSEcommerce) - the logic to reproduce
items.detail: Steps: (a) if idMagento>0, UpdateMagentoId (Intelisis write). (b) If ExistingCustomer is false → return 0. (c) idRef=GetIdRef(cliente,idCarrito) (ISNULL(MAX(IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce),'') gives '0' when there are no rows). telefonoValidado=GetValidatedPhoneNumber (Intelisis CteTel). (d) If idRef=='0': InsertCodigoVerificacion, a random 6-digit code expiring in 2 min. If there is a phone, InsertSendingSms and return 3. Otherwise fall through to return 0. (e) Otherwise estatusSms = the newest EstatusEnvio for IdMensaje 23. '1' → return 3 without resending. '2' or '3' → read the existing Codigo, INSERT a new VTASD row with the SAME code, re-read idRef, and if there is a phone InsertSendingSms and return 3. Empty status with a phone → InsertSendingSms with the existing idRef and return 3. Any other case → return 0. Any exception → -1. The C# code never returns 1 ('sin numero telefonico'): a missing phone gives 0.

items.topic: Intelisis READ Cte (ExistingCustomer) → SAP equivalent (exists)
items.detail: LAN runs 'SELECT 1 FROM Cte WHERE Cliente=@Cliente' on IntelisisTmp and checks only that the row exists. SAP equivalent 1: BusinessPartnerMethods.GetClientAsync, GET ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE_CDS/ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE?$filter=BusinessPartner eq '<BP>'&$top=1. It throws 'No se encontraron clientes' when there are 0 rows. It is already wrapped by OrderMethods.CheckClientCreditAsync, which swallows every exception and returns false (bug B2 in the runbook). A port would have to tell 'not found' (→0) apart from a transport failure (LAN →-1). SAP equivalent 2: GetClientMaAsync, GET ZAPI_BP05MA_SRV/BusinessPartnerSet(Partner='<BP>',Client='110')?$expand=to_CteTel,to_Cte,... Both are GET with Basic auth from CreateClientS4 and need no CSRF.

items.topic: Intelisis WRITE Cte.IDMagento (UpdateMagentoId) → SAP PATCH (exists)
items.detail: LAN runs 'UPDATE Cte SET IDMagento=@IdMagento WHERE Cliente=@Cliente' only when idMagento>0. The SAP equivalent already exists: BusinessPartnerMethods.LinkMagentoAccountAsync. It fetches a CSRF token (GetTokenSapAsync on <obtenerUrl>/ZSDT_CTE_ODATA_SRV/), then sends PATCH ZSDT_CTE_ODATA_SRV/ZSDT_CTE_ENTITYSet(ZclienteBp='<BP>') with body {"ZidMagento": id}. It throws on non-2xx and requires id_magento>0, which matches LAN's guard. It is exposed as PATCH partner/client/unircuenta. The value can be read back from BP05MA to_Cte.ZidMagento (int). Logs\sap.log contains no ZidMagento PATCH entry, so it has never been seen to run.

items.topic: Intelisis READ CteTel (GetValidatedPhoneNumber) → SAP CteTelSet / to_CteTel (read exists, LAN rule missing)
items.detail: LAN selects TOP 1 LADA+Telefono FROM CteTel WHERE Tipo='Movil' AND Telefono!='0' AND LEN(Telefono)+LEN(Lada)=10 AND Cliente=@Cliente AND ValidacionTel=1 ORDER BY Fecha DESC. Field map: Cliente→Partner (BP); Tipo='Movil'→ZtipoCte=='MOVIL' (SAP stores it upper case); Lada+Telefono→ZtelCte (the full 10-digit number, since SAP has no separate lada field); ValidacionTel→Zvaltel; Fecha→Zfecha. Read options: (a) GET <obtenerUrl>/ZQBP_EDITARCLIENTE_SRV/CteTelSet?$filter=Partner eq '<BP>'&sap-client=110&$format=json, which is already coded as the private SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.GetCteTelAsync and returns List<BusinessPhone>; (b) BP05MA to_CteTel through GetClientMaAsync. BusinessPhone has Partner, ZidcteTel, ZtipoCte, ZtelCte, Zfecha(string), Zenvionip, Zvaltel, ZappOrig, ZfechaCap, ZtelExist, ZtraeTel, Zintentos, ZtipoValid. The filter and ordering must be done in C#: MOVIL, Zvaltel, Length==10, !='0', Zfecha descending with nulls last (Zfecha has to be parsed; it is not a sortable string).

items.topic: Existing ServicioSAP phone lookups that are NOT LAN-equivalent (Q4)
items.detail: GetTelefonoValidadoAsync calls URL_BP_API/A_GET_TelefonoValidado?sCliente=. In businesspartner-dev, that route takes the newest phone of ANY type (ordered by Zfecha, ZfechaCap, ZidcteTel) and returns {ZtelCte, ZvalTel}. ServicioSAP then checks ZvalTel. The route filters neither MOVIL nor validated, so a newer non-validated phone hides an older validated one. OrderMethods.IsValidatedAsync (BP05MA to_CteTel) checks MOVIL + Zvaltel, ADDS a non-empty ZappOrig check that LAN's GetValidatedPhoneNumber does not have, and takes FirstOrDefault without ordering by date. For getSms, use one helper with LAN's exact rule (runbook §23.4 Q4/Q9).

items.topic: How businesspartner-dev READS CteTel (reference)
items.detail: _get_ctetelset runs GET {SERVICE_URL}/ZQBP_EDITARCLIENTE_SRV/CteTelSet with $format=json and Basic auth, and no CSRF on reads. It builds '$filter' from the optional fields Partner, ZidcteTel, ZtipoCte, ZtelCte, Zfecha, ZfechaCap and ZappOrig (joined with 'and', quotes escaped) or passes a raw $filter through. It replaces null Zfecha/ZfechaCap with '00000000' in the results, which means SAP can return null dates. Zvaltel and Zenvionip cannot be filtered in this wrapper, so they are filtered client-side.

items.topic: How businesspartner-dev WRITES CteTel (reference for any future phone write)
items.detail: (1) Add a phone: AS_POST_ZQBP_EditarCliente_CteTel fetches a CSRF token with GET on <SERVICE_URL>/ZQBP_EDITARCLIENTE_SRV/ and the header 'X-CSRF-Token: Fetch', keeping the session cookies. It then sends POST CteTelSet with the payload {Partner, ZidcteTel, ZtipoCte, ZtelCte, Zfecha 'YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00', Zenvionip, Zvaltel, ZappOrig, ZfechaCap, ZtelExist, ZtraeTel, Zintentos, ZtipoValid}. ZidcteTel is computed client-side as max(ZidcteTel)+1, padded to 10 digits. (2) Update: AS_PUT_ZQBP_EditarCliente_CteTel sends PUT CteTelSet(Partner='..',ZidcteTel='..') with the non-null fields and sets ZfechaCap=today when Zvaltel is true. A_POST_BPValidarTelefonoCOFETEL also uses PUT (:133), plus a POST with Zvaltel=true and ZtipoValid='Proceso Automatico' (:98-118). PUT is disabled in ServicioSAP. items.topic: ServicioSAP SubmitClientInfoAsync is not a safe phone-only update
items.detail: SubmitClientInfoAsync POSTs the whole Client model to ZAPI_BP01_PARTNER_SRV/BPartnerSet (CSRF from GetTokenSapAsync) with JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull. Client has non-nullable bools (Xsexm, Xblck, NotReleased, PersAddr, Stkzu, Xverr, Xzver, Loevm), and CteTel has non-nullable ZenvioNip, ZvalTel, ZtelExist and ZtraeTel. These are always serialized as false, so reusing this method to change one phone would also send false for those flags. Unlike patch_ClientesMavi, which strips empty values, it cannot send a partial update. A dedicated DTO or anonymous payload would be needed.

items.topic: validateSms data access - ServicioAndroid only, no SAP needed
items.detail: LAN calls SPVTASCodigoSeguridadeCommerce(@Cliente, @IdCarrito, @CodigoWeb=claveSms, @Op='CODIGO') on the ServicioAndroid connection and reads the ReturnValue. The CODIGO branch is: IF (SELECT TOP 1 IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce FROM VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce WHERE Cliente=@Cliente AND IdCarrito=@IdCarrito AND Codigo=@CodigoWeb)>0 RETURN 5 ELSE RETURN 6. It does not check FechaExpira or Estatus, so an expired code is still accepted, as it is in LAN today. The SP's other branch, @Op='NIP', reads and writes ERPMAVI.IntelisisTmp Cte (IDMagento, NIPVenta) and CteTel, so it must never be called. LAN's C# getSms replaced it. ServicioSAP has no validateSms method. Either call the SP with 'CODIGO' only, or port the single SELECT against MAVICBOSANDROID.

items.topic: Key change: SMS rows must be keyed by the BP that order/new later uses
items.detail: ServicioSAP's credit order path reads the SMS phone back with ObtenerNumeroTablaSmsAsync(sDatosPedido[36]), where [36]=cuenta (the BP). It runs SELECT TOP 1 Telefono FROM TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes WHERE IdRegistro IN (SELECT IdCodigoVerificacioneCommerce FROM VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce WHERE Cliente=@Cliente). SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.ObtenerTelefonoAValidarAsync reads TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes by Cliente. So the ported getSms must write Cliente = the same BP string (10 digits, e.g. 1500008218) and not an Intelisis 'C...' account. The SP's @Cliente is varchar(15), so 10 digits fit. The actual column widths are not in the corpus.
